input.description: main command selftest|check|check-package, default selftest; --json optional. Reject --package-contract-scope/--package-contract-evidence unconditionally as raw unbound source. selftest forbids --candidate-sha, --live-consumers and all eight package inputs. check-package requires --candidate-sha and all eight --package-contract-bundle, --package-contract-target-source, --package-contract-accepted-requirement-source, --package-contract-governance-policy-source, --package-contract-runtime-source, --package-contract-evidence-input, --package-contract-target-id, --expected-target-candidate; forbids --live-consumers. check requires --candidate-sha and --live-consumers; the eight package flags are optional as one complete group, but supplying only some triggers need('all-bundle-inputs-required') in run_check (ValueError rather than parser.error). Candidate and expected target candidate are 40-character lowercase hex validated before member checking; package membership invokes dynamically loaded fixed checker. Other commands do not automatically prove provider credentials or runtime sources exist.
conditions: Candidate alone is not enough for check-package; all eight package inputs are mandatory.
The selected package member may be omitted entirely in check (never check-package), but partial member inputs are rejected.
Only source-defined selftest has no candidate-related inputs; all three modes can choose --json.

check-package must validate v3 package_member before producing its package result; it does not load gov-release-identity and does not run selftest, production, migration or release-eligibility children.

check with any of the eight package fields supplied checks all eight and verifies package_member before load_identity, 12 regressions, current production child, migration, and release eligibility. Partial package fields raise ValueError before these later children.
selftest loads identity then invokes the 12 regression children; neither check-package nor pure import of identity.py alone performs that identity read.
